resources.string: Audio leaves this device over HDMI. Android cannot tell whether a TV or a receiver is connected, so the HDMI profile applies to both. Formats and channels always come from the connected device.
Audio goes to a soundbar or receiver over HDMI ARC or eARC. Formats and channels come from that device.
Audio plays from the TV speakers.
Audio goes to headphones or Bluetooth.
The TV profile applies. Formats and channels come from the current output.

For audio the output cannot play directly. Automatic: decoded on this device; for DTS-HD the DTS core is sent when possible. Dolby Digital (AC3): multichannel audio is sent as AC3 5.1 when PCM allows only stereo; Atmos height channels are lost. PCM only: always decode to PCM. Media server: Plex, Emby or Jellyfin convert the audio; other sources convert on this device. Off: no extra conversion.
